basic_info.description: Gorgeous View Duplex with BIG VACANT Top Owners Unit! Top unit is a bright and sunny 3BR, 2BA with *true* chefs kitchen with amazing views, gorgeous hardwood floors, crown molding and all the Victorian trim, wainscotting, and delicious details. Decorative fireplace in front bedroom, original pocket doors, center hall skylight &  tall tall tall ceilings! Smallest bedroom features a built-in loft bed or can be used as an office. 2-car parking, seismic upgrades & bonus space beyond the garage complete with bathroom & kitchenette. PLUS more storage, too! Sunny backyard perfect for gardening or BBQ with friends. Lower unit is tenant occupied, with market-rate rents. An excellent opportunity to live upstairs with an easy income property. A foodie's paradise: Steps to fabulous shops, restaurants and cafes on 18th St: Chez Maman, Goat Hill Pizza, Plow, Farley's, Whole Foods & more. Don't miss!
